scope: Source/security/dependency/provenance audit of the third-party OpenASR Qwen3-ASR-0.6B q8 packaging/runtime path as a lower-overhead local German ASR challenger. No target runtime or German benchmark credit.
critical_identity_finding: OpenASR pack is not proven to be a quantization of the F2 -hf baseline; the two current official Qwen model artifacts have different surfaced sizes and SHA-256 identities. Treat OpenASR q8 as a distinct checkpoint/runtime challenger unless an equivalence receipt proves otherwise.
backend_gate: OpenASR Qwen audit verifies CPU/Metal on cited M1 evidence but marks CUDA/Vulkan/HIP untested; target hardware receipt and backend-bound correctness smoke are required before performance credit on those paths.
